description: The line plot illustrates how varying the recent sequence ratio affects both model perplexity and GPU memory utilization during LLM inference, as evaluated on an A100 80GB GPU using LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, spans from 0 to 100 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, ranges from 4.2 to 4.7 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.1 intervals; the right y-axis, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, spans from 40 to 100 with a linear scale and tick marks at 10% intervals. The orange line with circle markers, labeled “Perplexity”, starts at approximately 4.6 at 5% recent sequence ratio, drops sharply to 4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly between 4.3 and 4.35 through 80%, before rising to 4.38 at 100%. The blue line with circle markers, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio”, begins at 40% at 5% recent sequence ratio and rises steadily in a near-linear fashion to 100% at 100%. Two horizontal reference lines are overlaid: a red dashed line at perplexity = 4.4, labeled “Full Cache PPL”, and a blue dashed line at GPU memory ratio = 100%, labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.” The legend, positioned at the top center, identifies the four plotted elements: Perplexity (orange solid line), Full Cache PPL (red dashed line), GPU Mem. Ratio (blue solid line), and Full Cache GPU Mem. (blue dashed line).
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio, evaluated using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. The x-axis is labeled 'Recent Sequence Ratio (%)' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and the left y-axis is labeled 'Perplexity' with a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7. The right y-axis is labeled 'GPU Mem. Ratio (%)' with a linear scale from 40 to 100. The orange line, representing perplexity, begins at approximately 4.6 at 5% recent sequence ratio, decreases steadily to 4.2 at 40%, and then stabilizes before increasing slightly to 4.3 at 100%. The blue line, representing GPU memory ratio, starts at 40% at 5% recent sequence ratio and increases linearly to 80% at 100%. Two horizontal reference lines are included: a red dashed line at a perplexity of 4.4 labeled 'Full Cache PPL,' and a blue dashed line at a GPU memory ratio of 100% labeled 'Full Cache GPU Mem.' The legend is positioned at the top center of the plot.
